selection: best validation PSNR (valid split of PanCollection)
train_note: training runs in segments of at most 48 h; continue an interrupted run with the same command plus --resume. The recipe is the method's published one, identical for the three arms.
infer: python scripts/infer.py --method PINO --arm original --train-set wv3 --split reduced --weights weights/PanBase --out-dir outputs/PINO/original/wv3_reduced
python scripts/infer.py --method PINO --arm original --train-set wv3 --split full --weights weights/PanBase --out-dir outputs/PINO/original/wv3_full
python scripts/infer.py --method PINO --arm original --train-set wv3 --eval-set wv2 --split reduced --weights weights/PanBase --out-dir outputs/PINO/original/wv2_reduced
python scripts/infer.py --method PINO --arm original --train-set wv3 --eval-set wv2 --split full --weights weights/PanBase --out-dir outputs/PINO/original/wv2_full
inference_seed: torch.manual_seed(0) immediately before each test image
